# Obligations checklist

Every normative statement of the Federation Tier with AQL specification,
on every page and in both JSON schemas, with the status FerroFED holds for
it. The [conformance matrix](conformance.md) scores the section 17 points;
this checklist also holds the obligations in the section prose that are no
point of their own. Each row of
[`conformance/obligations.tsv`](https://github.com/FerroHEALTH/FerroFED/blob/main/conformance/obligations.tsv)
quotes the statement and names the test, the code, the issue or the
report behind its status.

**Statements:** 447, of which 375 fall on the gateway.

## Counts per status

| Status | Statements | Gateway statements | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| tested | 342 | 340 | a test asserts it |
| built-untested | 0 | 0 | the code does it and no test asserts it yet |
| planned | 6 | 3 | not built yet; an open issue holds the work |
| missing | 0 | 0 | not built, found missing by the audit; an issue holds the work |
| deferred | 5 | 4 | not built, by a decision of the owner |
| new-gap | 8 | 7 | the text contradicts itself or is silent, found by the audit and reported on [#212](https://github.com/FerroHEALTH/FerroFED/issues/212) |
| contradiction | 7 | 6 | the text contradicts itself, reported on [#212](https://github.com/FerroHEALTH/FerroFED/issues/212) before the audit |
| node | 15 | 0 | a member node must meet it |
| operator | 24 | 0 | the federation operator must meet it |
| n/a | 40 | 15 | no gateway obligation: a client or an editor must meet it, or it is a permission the gateway does not take |

## Gaps

Every statement FerroFED does not yet meet as the text reads, and every
statement where the text disagrees with itself, by status.

None.

None.
